subject: Request: staged traffic surge mitigation + automatic fallback for A/B launch
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@bluecord.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged A/B launch — need temporary SLA mitigation and auto-fallback

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

We're ramping the A/B checkout experiment next week (BlueCord prod -> Redwood inference for suggestions). Our SREs want an agreement in place that lets us run a tightly controlled staged traffic surge with an automated safety fallback if latency or error rates spike. Specifically: 

- Phase: 0 -> 5% (10m), 5% -> 25% (30m), 25% -> 100% (2h)
- Safety triggers: p95 > 450ms sustained for 10 minutes OR error-rate > 1% for 5 minutes
- Action: immediate traffic swap back to vBaseline and pin to baseline for 1 hour (manual unpin after investigation)

Can Redwood authorize an SLA carveout for the above window and confirm you can implement an automated rollback + pin behavior? We attached our SLA-exception form and a short CC runbook of what we're going to do on our side.

We appreciate a quick turnaround — launch is scheduled Thu 2027-05-13 10:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform — BlueCord
Attachment: SLA-exception-form.pdf (application/pdf, 37KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@bluecord.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged A/B launch — need temporary SLA mitigation and auto-fallback

Samir — thanks for the clear plan and the form. Short answer: yes, we can support an automated contingency that meets those triggers, but we need to document the exact rollback semantics and get internal approvals for a temporary SLA carveout. Proposed items to lock down: 

1) Automated fallback behavior
   - Trigger window matching yours (p95 > 450ms for 10m OR error >1% for 5m)
   - Immediate routing swap to vBaseline with a forced version pin for 60 minutes
   - Rollback will execute via the traffic controller; we will emit an immediate notice and an annotation on the rollout record

2) Traffic caps and ramp cadence
   - Start at 2% for 15m (observe), then 10% (30m), 25% (45m), then to target 100% only after telemetry checks pass
   - Rate limit on the experiment group to avoid congestion cascading

3) Telemetry & alerting
   - We'll stream p95, p99, error-rate, tail CPU on the inference pool, and queue depth. BlueCord should confirm your alerting thresholds map to our signals (we'll share IDs).

4) SLA carveout scope
   - A timeboxed carveout limited to the launch window + 2 hours for stabilization. Any SLA credits will be negotiated if fallback is triggered and customer impact occurs.

I've looped Marcus (runtime) to confirm the technical execution and to prepare a brief runbook we can attach to the agreement. Laura — can you take this to policy/approvals and let us know if finance/legal require extra signoffs?

I'll attach a preliminary fallback-runbook for your review.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachment: fallback-runbook.md (text/markdown, 8KB)

Subject: Re: Staged A/B launch — need temporary SLA mitigation and auto-fallback

Kimberly / Marcus — this looks reasonable, and I support moving forward with the controls you outlined. Two small asks before I greenlight the carveout: 

- Please add an explicit rollback notification template that will be sent to BlueCord ops and to our customer success team at the first sign of trigger activation.
- Clarify whether pinning to baseline will be strict (no traffic allowed to experimental variant for the hour) or whether we allow a small 1% emergency test traffic. I prefer a strict pin for clarity.

Marcus, please confirm whether the traffic controller supports strict one-hour pin semantics and whether we can auto-generate the rollout annotation with a link to the incident ticket. If this is all positive I'll submit the temporary SLA carveout to legal (I expect a quick review).

Laura Bennett
VP, Product — Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged A/B launch — need temporary SLA mitigation and auto-fallback

Quick tech confirmation: we can implement exactly the automation described. Details: 

- Controller: traffic-control v2 supports rule-based immediate swap and a version-level pin flag. We will implement a workflow: detect -> annotate rollout -> execute swap -> set pin TTL=3600s.
- Telemetry mapping: we'll publish telemetry endpoints (p95/p99/error-rate) under the rollout namespace and provide the signal IDs to Samir for their alerting.
- Safety: we'll add a hard stop that prevents progressive ramp beyond 25% unless approval is acknowledged by an on-call or the BlueCord SRE token (OID).
- Notifications: on trigger we'll auto-create a ticket in Jira (SUP-4321) and post a Teams/Slack alert to both teams. We'll attach the runbook and the generated incident link to the rollout record.

I'll kick off a short run (dry-run) in our staging environment Friday afternoon and share logs. If all good, Laura — please proceed with policy approval and I'll standby for a quick config push.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Staff Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
